title: Social norm
author: Wikipedia contributors
paragraphs: A social norm or norm is a shared standard of acceptable behavior by a group. Social norms can both be informal understandings that govern the behavior of members of a society, as well as be codified into rules and laws. Social normative influences or social norms, are deemed to be powerful drivers of human behavioural changes and well organized and incorporated by major theories which explain human behaviour. Institutions are composed of multiple norms. Norms are shared social beliefs about behavior; thus, they are distinct from "ideas", "attitudes", and "values", which can be held privately, and which do not necessarily concern behavior. Norms are contingent on context, social group, and historical circumstances.

Scholars distinguish between regulative norms (which constrain behavior), constitutive norms (which shape interests), and prescriptive norms (which prescribe what actors ought to do). The effects of norms can be determined by a logic of appropriateness and logic of consequences; the former entails that actors follow norms because it is socially appropriate, and the latter entails that actors follow norms because of cost-benefit calculations. Others see social norms emerging as part of an evolutionarily stable strategy, where they stabilize through third-party punishment.

Norms can have strong effects on human behavior and can promote social control across many cultures. Those who do not conform with social norms are considered "deviants." The life cycle of a norm occurs in three stages: (1) Norm emergence – norm entrepreneurs seek to persuade others of the desirability and appropriateness of certain behaviors; (2) Norm cascade – when a norm obtains broad acceptance; and (3) Norm internalization – when a norm acquires a "taken-for-granted" quality. Norms are robust to various degrees: some norms are often violated whereas other norms are so deeply internalized that violations are infrequent. Evidence for the existence of norms can be detected in the patterns of behavior within and across social groups, as well as their articulation in group discourse.

Many disciplines study norms, including sociologists, psychologists, political scientists, and economists. Within and across these disciplines, academics study several types of norms, including political norms and gender norms.

sentence.text: Norms are contingent on context, social group, and historical circumstances.
sentence.translation: 规范取决于具体情境、社会群体和历史背景。
sentence.analysis: 主干为 Norms are contingent on…。be contingent on 表示“取决于”；context、social group 和 historical circumstances 是介词 on 后的三个并列成分，说明规范所依赖的条件。

questions.question: 根据第一段，社会规范与个人可能持有的观念或态度有什么区别？
options: 规范是群体共享的行为标准，而观念或态度可以由个人私下持有
规范只能写在法律中，不能是不成文的
规范必然适用于所有历史时期和所有群体
规范只描述自然规律，不涉及行为
questions.explanation: 第一段强调 shared social beliefs about behavior，并将规范与可以 privately held、未必涉及行为的观念等区分。
hints: 分别列出两个概念的特征，再比较相同点和不同点。
回到第 1 段，逐项核对主体、范围及表示条件或程度的词。

questions.question: 文中的 norm internalization 指哪种情况？
options: 一种规范刚刚由某人提出但无人接受
一种规范被视为理所当然
一种规范仅成为书面讨论的标题
一种规范的所有违反行为都被忽略
